title: Basketball Stars 3 auto green
features: Auto green without a hub use it in the private server no key needed
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Create the RemoteEvent if your game doesn't already have one
local shootEvent = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("ShootBall")

if not shootEvent then
	shootEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	shootEvent.Name = "ShootBall"
	shootEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

-- Shooting settings
local PERFECT_WINDOW = 0.15
local SHOT_POWER = 70

local function shoot()
	-- Simulate perfect timing
	local releaseTime = 0

	if math.abs(releaseTime) <= PERFECT_WINDOW then
		shootEvent:FireServer("Perfect", SHOT_POWER)
	else
		shootEvent:FireServer("Normal", SHOT_POWER)
	end
end

-- Example: press E to shoot
game:GetService("UserInputService").InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if processed then return end

	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then
		shoot()
	end
end)
